title: AIEDS Disclosure
description: AI Energy Disclosure Standard v1 - a single disclosure record for an AI subject's energy consumption and carbon footprint. AIEDS scope is device / usage / inference / training and is NOT the planetary Earth health score produced by rand0m.ai's earthHealthScoreRefresh function.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI - may be included for editor tooling.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this disclosure record. UUID or URI recommended (e.g. 'aieds:my-model:inference:2026-06-29:001').

subject.description: The AI subject this disclosure covers.

kind.description: model = a foundation/fine-tuned model; agent = an orchestrated AI agent; app = an AI-powered application.

version.description: Optional semver or other version string.

scope.description: Measurement boundary. 'device' = client device energy (CPU/GPU/display) running an AI app; 'usage' = device + server-side inference combined; 'inference' = server-side inference only; 'training' = model training run. AIEDS v1 is optimised for device/usage/inference (agent-native). Training disclosures are supported but factor tables are inference-focused.

window.description: ISO 8601 duration this disclosure covers (e.g. 'P30D' = 30 days, 'PT15M' = 15 minutes, 'PT1H' = 1 hour).

compute.description: Optional compute metrics used to derive energyKWh. Provide at least one of tokens, gpuSeconds, or flops for provenance; omit if energy was measured directly.

gpuSeconds.description: Wall-clock GPU-seconds consumed across all accelerators.

hardware.description: Accelerator identifier (e.g. 'NVIDIA H100 SXM', 'Google TPU v4'). Used with gpuSeconds to derive energy.

energyKWh.description: Total energy consumed in kilowatt-hours for the declared scope and window.

gCO2e.description: Total greenhouse gas emissions in grams of CO2-equivalent. Must be derived as energyKWh x gridIntensity.gCO2ePerKWh (within rounding tolerance).

gridIntensity.description: Grid carbon intensity applied to convert energy to CO2e.

gCO2ePerKWh.description: Carbon intensity in grams of CO2-equivalent per kilowatt-hour.

region.description: Grid region or country code used (e.g. 'US', 'EU27', 'France', 'global_average').

confidence.description: Confidence in the energyKWh figure. String enum or fractional 0 to 1. 'high' = direct hardware power measurement; 'med' = GPU-seconds x TDP factor; 'low' = token or FLOP proxy.

methodologyVersion.description: AIEDS methodology version (semver, e.g. '1.0.0'). Must match the published version in spec/methodology.md.

source.description: URI or name of the tool or process that generated this disclosure (e.g. 'aieds-mcp v1.0.0', 'my-energy-meter v2').

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this disclosure was generated.
